Costing summary

Calculation details

Parts = quantity × internal unit cost. Add-ons = quantity × unit kit add-on. Existing four-pot and treble-bleed-pair charges are divided by their covered quantities to obtain a unit rate; each line shows its saved basis. Lines are rounded to the nearest penny.

Sale price = base + add-ons. Fees = sale price × percentage + fixed fee. Labour = hourly rate × minutes ÷ 60.

Gross profit = sale price − parts − packaging − fees. Net profit = gross profit − labour. Margins divide profit by sale price; a £0 sale has no calculated margin. VAT and other overheads are not separately modelled.
